# mmaemu

> Bit-accurate emulation of NVIDIA tensor-core FP8 GEMM numerics for PyTorch: the bits of `torch._scaled_mm` on a
> reference GPU (RTX 4060), computed on a CPU or another CUDA GPU.

One reference platform (RTX 4060, cuBLASLt 12.8.3.14) is modelled and validated against 173 recordings of its
hardware. `mmaemu.scaled_mm` takes the arguments of `torch._scaled_mm`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/README.md): what mmaemu is for, results, install, quickstart, related work
- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/docs/user_guide.md): a first GEMM, profiles, split-K, backends, use inside a model, testing
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/docs/api.md): every public function and class, the exceptions and warnings, the command line
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/docs/faq.md): short answers to the first questions
- [Evo 2 on other GPUs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/docs/evo2.md): routing Evo 2's FP8 projections through mmaemu (1B, and 40B with the weights in host RAM), measured results
- [Semantics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/docs/semantics.md): exactly what is computed, and what raises
- [Limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astding/mmaemu/master/docs/limitations.md): what v0.1 does not do

## Examples

- [Evo 2 1B notebook](https://github.com/astding/mmaemu/blob/master/examples/evo2_blackwell.ipynb): upstream Evo 2 1B on an RTX 5070 Ti with its FP8 projections computed by mmaemu
- [Evo 2 with the weights in host RAM](https://github.com/astding/mmaemu/blob/master/examples/evo2_offload.py): upstream Evo 2 40B on a 16 GB GPU with its FP8 projections computed by mmaemu: the upstream test and the scoring of sequences
